integrity: The proof is analytic; the included finite numerical check is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the exact fixed-regularization iteration on finite-dimensional real SPD quadratics only.
The asymptotic active eigenvalue depends on the spectral support of the initial vector.
No guarantee is asserted for line-search variants, nonquadratic objectives, inexact solves, or finite-precision behavior.
Literature comparison is targeted rather than exhaustive; a prior explicit derivation may remain undiscovered.
title: Exact active-eigenspace asymptotics for gradient-regularized Newton on SPD quadratics
